name: Spokane Winter 2023

venue.name: Spokane First Church of the Nazarene
venue.address: 9004 N Country Homes Blvd, Spokane, WA 99218

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpokaneSummer2023#30471-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)!

Please be aware of Covid-19 precautions and read [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpokaneSummer2023#30470-covid-19-safety) before registering.

This competition is organized and presented by Pacific Northwest Cubing.  Visit us on Facebook by clicking the logo below!
